Taylor (Finance): FYI the March invoice shows ~ $22k of GPU usage billed at on-demand rates even though we have committed use discounts (CUD) for those projects. This looks like the commitment didn't apply. :confused:

billing-bot: invoice 2026-03-01 posted (invoice_id: inv_20260301). Billing export available in BigQuery.

Maya (Cloud Infra): Which projects? can you paste the BQ query you used?

Taylor (Finance): Quick join I ran:```sql
SELECT b.project_id, SUM(b.cost) AS billed_cost, SUM(u.estimated_committed_cost) AS expected_cost
FROM `redwood-billing.gcp_export.gcp_billing_export_v1_YYYY` b
LEFT JOIN `redwood-billing.commitments.cud_usage_v1` u
  ON b.sku_id = u.sku_id AND b.usage_start_time = u.usage_date
WHERE b.service_description LIKE '%GPU%'
GROUP BY b.project_id
ORDER BY billed_cost - expected_cost DESC
LIMIT 20;```

Ravi (Eng Platform): Looks like projects: model-prod, dedicated-inference, and partner-sandboxes are top. My guess: some VMs were launched in the wrong region where our CUDs don't cover. Will check instance locations and reservation mapping.

Priya (Vendor Ops): I cc'd the reseller contact. If this is a region mismatch we can request a bill adjustment or apply an internal credit. Need exact usage ids and timestamps. @CloudSales-Bot can you pull commitment assignment for our billing account?

CloudSales-Bot: Commitment assignment pulled for billing account 0123-4567-89AB: commitments covering us: us-central1 (n1-standard+T4) 100%, europe-west1 (a100) 60%.

Maya (Cloud Infra): confirmed: ~60% of the uncommitted charges are from europe-west1 where our CUD only covers a subset of SKUs. There were emergency inference jobs spun up in europe-west1 on 2026-02-27 for latency testing.

Taylor (Finance): Ok. Action items for finance approval of any vendor credit request: 1) list of affected invoice line items (instance IDs + usage timestamps), 2) confirmation of commitment coverage and region mismatch, 3) proposed internal allocation if vendor declines.

Ravi (Eng Platform): I'll export instance-level usage from Stackdriver/audit logs and match to SKUs. Will attach a CSV to the Jira dispute ticket.

Priya (Vendor Ops): I'll open a formal dispute with the reseller and ask for a pro-rated credit while they investigate. Requesting CF-3721 on your behalf.

Taylor (Finance): For internal bookkeeping, propose charging model-prod $12,000, dedicated-inference $7,000, partner-sandboxes $3,000 provisional until vendor resolves. Finance will post a provisional journal entry and then reverse/adjust based on outcome.

Maya (Cloud Infra): Can we also add an anomaly alert for bill rate changes >25% day-over-day for GPU SKUs? I can add a daily compare job and alert #finance and #eng-ml.

Ravi (Eng Platform): I'll add a Terraform guard to prevent launching GPU SKUs in regions not covered by an active CUD unless tagged with "override: true" and a one-line reason. That will help.

billing-bot: created billing-dispute D-20260302-01, linked to invoice inv_20260301.

Taylor (Finance): Thanks. Please drop the CSV + audit mapping into BT-9932 (billing dispute) and tag me. We'll review and post provisional chargebacks tomorrow morning.

Priya (Vendor Ops): pinged reseller, they acknowledged. ETA 3-5 business days.

Maya (Cloud Infra): uploaded region mapping and instance list to the ticket.

Ravi (Eng Platform): added the Terraform change to a PR: infra/guard/gpu-region-check.

Taylor (Finance): Looping in legal if vendor pushes back. Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene on this thread after the reseller replies. :thumbsup:
